key_points: PepsiCo hit a 52‑week low and fell more than the broader market on Sep 30.
Multiple analysts (Evercore, Barclays, JPMorgan) cut price targets or downgraded the stock ahead of earnings.
The board added J&J CEO Joaquin Duato, bringing healthcare expertise and a modest positive signal.
PepsiCo extended its dividend streak with a 4% hike, supporting income‑focused investors.
Upcoming quarterly earnings (early Oct) will be a key catalyst; current sentiment is weighed down by growth concerns in North American snacks.
